# GENOSYS Middle East FZ-LLC

> Official distributor of GENOSYS professional Korean dermacosmetics in the United Arab Emirates (UAE). TDRA-licensed, VAT-registered, operating in the UAE since 2019. We provide premium microneedling devices, skincare serums, creams, and professional beauty treatments for licensed practitioners and consumers. Free shipping on orders over 1000 AED across all 7 emirates.

## Brand Pillars

- **Clinical dermacosmetics** — formulas used by dermatologists and clinics across Korea, now available to UAE consumers and professionals. R&D rooted in microneedling and growth-factor research.
- **Official UAE distributor** — TDRA-licensed, VAT-registered, Dubai Municipality certified (Montaji System). Operating in the UAE since 2019. Authentic product guaranteed.
- **Made in South Korea** — every formula produced in GENOSYS laboratories in Seoul, Korea by DTS MG Co., Ltd.

## Company Information

- [About GENOSYS Middle East](https://genosys.ae/about): Official distributor of DTS MG Co., Ltd. (Korea) in the UAE since 2019. TDRA-licensed, VAT-registered, Dubai Municipality certified (Montaji System). Based in Dubai.
- [GENOSYS Brand Story](https://genosys.ae/brand): Korean dermacosmetics brand founded in Seoul. Professional-grade skincare backed by clinical research. Available in 40+ countries.

## Products

- [All Products](https://genosys.ae/products): Complete catalog of GENOSYS professional Korean dermacosmetics including serums, creams, masks, microneedling devices, and skincare solutions. Prices in AED.

## Shop by Skin Concern

- [Sun Protection](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/sun-protection): Professional SPF sunscreens for UAE intense UV climate. Broad-spectrum protection, lightweight formulas.
- [Acne Treatment](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/acne-treatment): Problem control serums, creams & toners for breakouts and blemishes. Oil-regulating active ingredients.
- [Pigmentation](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/pigmentation): Brightening serums & creams to reduce dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and uneven skin tone.
- [Scars Treatment](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/scars-treatment): Microneedling devices & repair serums for acne scars, surgical scars, and skin texture improvement.
- [Hair Loss](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/hair-loss): Scalp care products & microneedling for hair growth stimulation and follicle strengthening.
- [Anti-Aging](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/anti-aging): EGF, peptide, and anti-wrinkle formulations for fine lines, deep wrinkles, and loss of firmness.
- [Hydration](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/hydration): Multi-weight hyaluronic acid serums and moisture creams for UAE's dry, air-conditioned environments.
- [Sensitive Skin](https://genosys.ae/products/concern/sensitivity): Soothing, barrier-repair products for reactive skin caused by UAE heat, AC, and hard water.
